evidence: Admission now must contain runtime_observation_sha256 and pre_stage_preservation_receipt_sha256, both compared against exact read bytes before controller.prepare.

Expected backup list derives from the pinned controller plan: exactly five entries, original ledger first, then four controller_paths task/source/backup-name triples. Each live source and backup byte hash must match the externally pinned preservation receipt.
All saved artifact basenames and hashes are checked, and original_rows.json has both its byte hash and canonical content hash validated before any phase mutation.
Post-registration checks retain original scope/admission/base rows and explicitly rehash the four workbench sources.
Both entrypoints now execute an explicit if sys.flags.optimize: raise RuntimeError before project imports, project path reads or output creation.
Unlike assert, this guard is not removed by optimized compilation; therefore the remaining wrapper asserts cannot silently disappear in a supported execution.

unchanged_boundaries: No call to execute/apply/resume and no Gateway construction was added; the registration process still overrides Gateway.run with a failure trap.
Exclusive-create output paths and frozen controller phase identity/lease protections remain.
The new stage is an explicit time resource on the same original domain; this review does not create or approve its actual start/end, scope, admission or budget.
If a post-prepare verification fails, preserve the failure and inspect saved state; the registration may already exist and must not be blindly retried or dispatched.
